From: Ron.Colangelo@detroittigers.com <Ron.Colangelo@detroittigers.com>
Sent: Friday, February 21, 2014 9:11 PM
To: Lowe, John
Subject: Tigers Tickets, promotions

Individual game tickets for the 2014 Detroit Tigers season go on saleSaturday, March 1 beginning at 10:00 a.m. Fans will have the opportunity to purchase single game tickets at the Comerica Park Box Office on Witherell Street, online at tigers.com, and by calling 866-66-TIGER (84437).
New for the 2014 season, the Tigers will introduce dynamic ticket pricing.
Statement on Dynamic pricing:

“Dynamic pricing is based on consumer demand and generally affords fans who buy early to save more,” said Duane McLean, Executive Vice President, Business Operations. “With dynamic pricing you could see the value of ticket prices increase and decrease based on demand. Season tickets are not affected by dynamic pricing and continue to offer the most significant savings whereas dynamic pricing more accurately prices tickets for individual games.”
Notes:

Ø The Tigers will rank in the 12-14 range among MLB clubs in average ticket prices for 2014. This rank/range remains dependent on the other MLB clubs and their pricing.
(Ranked 13th in 2013).
Ø The Tigers anticipate the average ticket price in 2014 to be in the $31.00 range. (average ticket price in 2013 was $29.54).
Ø More than 400,000 tickets for the 2014 season will be priced at $20 or less when tickets go on sale.
Ø Individual prices range$9-$95 depending on the game (Lowest price in 2013 was $12)
o (Highest price point, $95 is On Deck for premium games, but not really available since those are generally sold out as Full season tickets)
Ø $9 = Value games in the new Jungle Rooftop seating (official name TBD). 325 seats/gm
o New area will be $17 on premium dates and $12 on regular dates

The Tigers have planned 33 giveaways for the season, in addition to 17 postgame fireworks extravaganzas, courtesy of Pepsi, following Friday and Saturday nightbaseball in Detroit. Visit tigers.comfor the complete 2014 home schedule and promotional giveaway lineup.

HIGHLIGHTED SEASON GIVEAWAYS
Sunday, April 20 – Torii Hunter Silver Slugger Mini Bat (All Kids)
Friday, May 9 – Miguel Cabrera Three-time Batting Champion Trophy (First 10,000 fans, sponsored by Pepsi)
Thursday, June 5 – Max Scherzer 2013 Cy Young Award Winner Bobblehead (First 10,000 fans, sponsored by BallPark)
Monday, June 30 – 1984 World Series Champion 30th Anniversary Replica Road Jersey (First 20,000 fans, sponsored by Comerica Bank)
Saturday, August 2 – Ivan “Pudge” Rodriguez Collectible Figurine (First 15,000 adults, sponsored by Miller Lite)
Thursday, August 14 – Justin Verlander Mini-Bobblehead (First 10,000 fans, sponsored by Frito Lay)
Friday, August 15 – Miguel Cabrera Back-to-Back MVP Bobblehead (First 10,000 fans)

EVERY KID, EVERY SUNDAY
As part of Sunday Kids Days "Every Kid, Every Sunday" will return and includes a giveaway guarantee, with all kids 14-and-younger receiving a promotional item on Sundays. In addition to every child receiving a free promotional item, children can enjoy free rides on the Comerica Bank Carousel or the Fly Ball Ferris Wheel. There is free face painting at Gates A and B and after the game all children are invited down to the field for the traditional Kids Run the Bases courtesy of Aquafina.

SEASON TICKETS ON SALE NOW
A variety of season ticket options for the upcoming 2014 season are currently on sale. Ticket packages are available for as low as $15 per game and include great benefits. For more information or to purchase season tickets, call (313) 471-2255, emailseasontickets@tigers.mlb.com or visit tigers.com.
Sent from Ron Colangelo's iPhone
